chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 556: Shangguan Yuting – The Unspeakable Reveals Itself
chapter_meta_description: The "trade" with the Supreme Extremity Confluence turns violent. Zhuge Yuan names a terrifying new faction—the Unspeakable—that cannot be named at all.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 556 – The Unspeakable Heist
og_description: Shangguan Yuting's true purpose is revealed as the Office official forcibly merges secrets into her body. Li Huowang learns of a being born from the void.
twitter_title: The Unspeakable Arrives — Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 556
twitter_description: A faction that cannot be spoken or written down makes its debut. Li Huowang just signed up to be its errand boy.

lore_anchors.definition: A supernatural entity that stores or exchanges secrets; in this chapter it is forcibly "harvested" by the Supervisory Heavenly Office official against its will.
A primordial being or sect that cannot be named by mortal mouths or recorded in writing; born from the void, it can only be glimpsed at the edges of death or extreme grief.
A corrupted Nian beast that drains yang life on contact, distinct from the traditional folkloric Nian.
Li Huowang's weapon, made from a human spine; a signature item of his grim aesthetic.
Shangguan Yuting's respectful address for Li Huowang, a recurring alias from earlier in the narrative.
The pendant Li Huowang inherited from Senior Brother Xuan Yang at Qingfeng Temple; now used as currency for a horse, symbolizing the burning of his last ties to that era.
